audience: small businesses that send bills and invoices to customers with everbill

useCases.title: Create a customer and a bill, then send it by email
useCases.text: Search for the customer, or create one. Create a bill with its line items, then send the bill PDF by email. The email goes to a real customer.

useCases.title: Check which bills are still open
useCases.text: List the latest bills with their status. Open a bill to see its customer, line items and payments.

useCases.title: Get the PDF of a bill by its number
useCases.text: Open a bill to read its details. Get its PDF by document number, with the file name and byte length.

useCases.title: Add a product or service to the article list
useCases.text: List the articles to check for an existing product or service. Add a new article with its name, unit and net price.
